validated_results.title: Processed meat consumption and risk of cancer: a multisite case-control study in Uruguay.
validated_results.reason: This multisite case-control study reports multivariable-adjusted odds ratios and 95% confidence intervals for processed meat intake and renal cell carcinoma risk stratified by sex.

extraction.comparison_type: Tertile III (>=28.3 g/day) vs Tertile I (<=11.4 g/day)
extraction.population: Patients admitted to four major public health hospitals of Montevideo

comparison.excerpt: Tertiles Grams per day Cancer site I ⩽11.4 OR (reference) II 11.5–28.2 OR (95% CI) III 28.3+ OR (95% CI)
